result.summary: A residential intersection featuring marked continental crosswalks and curb ramps. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, sightlines are partially obstructed by utility poles and dense vegetation, and there is a lack of active traffic control for the main thoroughfare.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: A large utility pole and dense vegetation at the corner block sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-right corner of the intersection near the utility pole.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The main road lacks traffic signals or stop signs, requiring pedestrians to find gaps in traffic without assistance.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the roadway.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Clear vegetation near the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to the crosswalk to increase driver yielding rates.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility continental crosswalks and basic sidewalk infrastructure in a residential setting. However, the lack of active traffic control on the primary road and potential sightline obstructions from corner vegetation increase risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense hedges and trees at the corners may prevent drivers from seeing pedestrians waiting to cross until they are already in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Far right and far left corners of the intersection.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The main thoroughfare lacks stop signs or signals, requiring pedestrians to rely on driver compliance at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the intersection corners to ensure clear sightlines between all road users.

interventions.title: RRFB Installation
interventions.description: Add Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to the crosswalk to alert drivers to the presence of pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and well-maintained sidewalks with curb ramps. However, the environment lacks active traffic control devices like stop signs or signals, and the wide roadway geometry may encourage higher vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: No visible stop signs or traffic signals are present to regulate vehicle flow at the marked crosswalk.

hazards.name: Wide Turning Radii
hazards.description: The corner geometry appears wide, which can facilitate higher vehicle speeds during turns across the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to increase driver yielding rates at the uncontrolled crossing.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or a traffic signal to provide clear right-of-way and manage vehicle speeds.

result.summary: This residential intersection features well-maintained sidewalks, marked zebra crosswalks, and curb ramps. While basic infrastructure is present, the crossing lacks advanced safety features like pedestrian signals or physical traffic calming measures beyond speed cushions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Mature trees and a wooden perimeter fence at the corner may partially block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially children.
hazards.location_in_image: Right-hand corner of the intersection behind the stop sign.

hazards.name: Unsignalized Crossing
hazards.description: The primary roadway lacks a stop control or signal, requiring pedestrians to rely on driver compliance at the marked crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main road.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to the crossing signs to increase driver yield rates.
